theme_strategy.description: Dark-mode default with deep forest and olive tones rather than pure black. High contrast for the camera view, maintaining a natural, organic feel suited for food and nutrition. UI Language: Italian.

rules: NO generic fonts for headings (NO Inter, Roboto, Open Sans).
Headings (Outfit) must use tight tracking (-0.02em to -0.04em).
Overlines and macro labels must be uppercase, tiny (text-xs), and widely spaced (tracking-[0.2em]).
Maximum H1 size is text-5xl. Use leading-none for headings, leading-relaxed for body.

surfaces.name: Crystal Glass
surfaces.usage: Bottom Navigation, Floating Modals, Camera Overlays

decorations: Soft ambient glowing blobs (e.g., bg-[#81B29A]/10 blur-3xl) behind main circular progress charts.
1px solid strokes for list items to maintain the 'Surgical Minimalism' trend.

grids_and_layouts.strategy: Mobile-first web app layout. Constrain max width for desktop (`max-w-md mx-auto`) to mimic a mobile device.
grids_and_layouts.bento_grid: For the Diario/Dashboard, use a dense bento grid: `grid-cols-2 gap-4`. Macro cards span 1 column, the daily calorie ring spans full width (col-span-2).
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous internal spacing inside cards (`p-5` or `p-6`). Add extra bottom padding (`pb-28`) on scrollable views to clear the floating bottom navigation.

interactions: Camera Snap: Scale down slightly on press (`active:scale-95`), followed by a white screen flash.
AI Scanning: A scanning line overlaid on the image with a subtle pulse animation during the 'analyzing' state.
Page Transitions: Smooth fade and slide up using framer-motion.
Ring Progress: Smooth animated stroke-dashoffset on load.

components.camera_view: Full height container representing the camera feed. Include a centered, tactile shutter button.
components.progress_rings: Use pure SVG to create overlapping or side-by-side circular progress bars for Calorie and Macros.
components.bottom_nav: Floating pill shape (`rounded-full mx-auto bottom-6`) acting as the primary navigation hub. 3 icons: Diario, Fotocamera, Profilo.

image_urls.description: Placeholder for a scanned meal (Insalata Mista) in the Diary history.
Secondary placeholder for a scanned meal.
User profile avatar for the Profile (Profilo) screen.

accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='btn-snap-photo'`).
accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA contrast. No completely transparent backgrounds under text.

libraries.components: shadcn/ui (Progress, Tabs, Dialog - heavily customized to avoid the default look)

instructions_to_main_agent: Write all UI text in Italian (Diario, Fotocamera, Profilo, Proteine, Carboidrati, Grassi, Fibre, Calorie, Obiettivo, etc.).
Do NOT center align the app container text globally.
Build a mobile-first UI with `max-w-md mx-auto relative h-screen overflow-hidden` as the main wrapper for desktop viewing.

Simulate the camera using either `navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia` or an 'Upload/Take Photo' standard file input if camera access fails. Show a clear 'Analisi in corso...' state when calculating macros.
Use SVG for the circular progress bars (Rings) to show daily progress. Color code them strictly using the macros palette.
Make the bottom navigation a floating Glassmorphism pill over the content.
Ensure `data-testid` is added to all buttons, inputs, and major layout sections.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight. Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients. Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy. Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur). You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms. You MUST NOT center align the app container. Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style. NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Every interaction needs micro-animations. Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Subtle grain textures, custom cursors, selection states. Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui. Use sonner for toasts.
